text:
james: Heads-up — customer finance team flagged a rejected invoice. AP says our PDF is missing the legal entity name (the one they need on their PO) and VAT placement is wrong. They shared the rejection note: 'Requires vendor legal entity + VAT ID in header'.

maya: Which invoice id? can you paste the invoice PDF link/id and customer PO?

james: invoice_2025_0423 (generated via /invoices API), PO: PO-99812. PDF template reported as `billing-v1`. Link: https://redwood-invoices.s3/.../invoice_2025_0423.pdf (customer redacted).

priya: Is this the multi-entity account where customers can be billed from either Redwood LLC or Redwood EU SARL? If so we need the legal entity printed on the header line 1 and the company reg/VAT on line 2 for EU.

james: yep, it's a multi-entity customer (EU region). Their AP requires: vendor legal entity name, full address, VAT ID, and PO number on the top-right block. Right now PO is only in the footer.

tara: Repro steps from our side: call `POST /v1/invoices/generate` with body {"account_id":"acct-eu-009","line_items":[...],"billing_entity":"auto"}. The template picks entity by `billing_entity=auto` and falls back to a single generic header. Seems `billing_entity` wasn't honored for this account.

sam_engineer: Checking logs — template engine returned `billing-v1` but with `entity_override=null`. Looks like a regression after the header refactor (PR #3214). I can reproduce locally with the same payload.

maya: Customer wants two fixes: 1) include explicit legal entity name and full registered address in header when account has multiple legal entities 2) move VAT ID to header area (not only in line-item tax table) 3) include PO in header block.

priya: For VAT we also need per-line VAT breakdown for some customers in the EU (reverse-charge notes). Can we make VAT appear both inline per line and summarized in header? the AP team asked for a header summary + per-line tax column.

sam_engineer: Proposed patch: modify template renderer to prefer `billing_entity` resolution order: explicit param > account default > invoice-level override. Add fields `header.vat_id`, `header.legal_name`, `header.registered_address`, `header.po_number`. I'll draft a small fallback so non-EU invoices keep current layout.

james: Can we hotfix for this customer's rejected invoice? they're blocked from payment until we reissue.

maya: We should reissue a corrected invoice PDF and mark original as superseded. Priya — any accounting impacts for reissued invoice numbers?

priya: We can issue a corrected invoice with new invoice id (invoice_2025_0423-R1) and keep the original archived. Need finance approval for reissued docs, but it's standard. Make sure `tax_breakdown` per line still sums to totals.

sam_engineer: I'll push a hotfix branch and attach a patch to this thread. Plan: 1) quick template change + env flag `BILLING_V1_LEGAL_HEADER=1` 2) generate corrected PDF 3) post back to support with regenerated PDF. ETA 2-3 hrs.

invoice-bot: Deploy started: billing-template-service v1.12.7-hotfix to staging at 1767000038.

james: Thanks — I'll reply to the customer and request they hold payments until we reissue. I'll share the corrected PDF when ready. :thumbsup:

maya: After hotfix, let's add a unit test for multi-entity header and a doc note in billing-devdocs about required header fields for EU APs (legal name, VAT ID, PO placement).

sam_engineer: Agree. I'll add tests and a short migration note. Will ping when staging PDF looks right.

james: Customer follow-up: 'Can you include our billing address in the top-left and company reg number on the same line as VAT?' I'll include that in the reproduction notes for the patch.

priya: Ok. Also flag for tax team: some customers require the VAT label to be "VAT ID" vs "VAT number". We should allow localization keys.

maya: Good catch. Add `header.vat_label` configurable per account.

invoice-bot: Deploy succeeded to staging at 1767000060.

sam_engineer: Staging PDF generated: https://staging.redwood-invoices/.../invoice_2025_0423-R1-staging.pdf — header now shows "Redwood EU SARL" + address + VAT ID + PO-99812 in header block. Per-line tax column retained. Please validate.

james: I sent to customer AP. They confirmed preliminary acceptance; will confirm final payment after official reissue. I'll update thread when they ack.

maya: After customer confirms, coordinate with finance to reissue final invoice id and mark original superseded. Thanks team.

priya: Noted — will prepare reissue process and accounting entries once we get confirmation.

sam_engineer: Closing loop: I'll open RFC in `eng-docs` for template v2 changes and include examples for EU multi-entity PDFs.

james: Closing this thread for now — will reopen if customer reports any remaining formatting rejects.
